Proposition
[Infinite expansion or cylinder limit] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0125, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0126 ↗ prop:chow-iv-zero-backward-pressure-round ↗ lem:chow-iv-backward-pressure-at-most-two-zeros ↗ prop:chow-iv-plane-not-backward-pointwise-limit 1. ch29:29.36\group Backward Pressure Limit

For a nonround solution, after a conformal diffeomorphism, there is $\mu >0$ such that \[ v(t)\longrightarrow v_\infty (\psi ,\theta )=\mu \cos ^2\psi \] in $C^{1,\alpha }(S^2)$ and smoothly on compact subsets away from the poles. Equivalently, the backward metric limit on the punctured sphere is a flat cylinder.
